title: A systematic review of macaque brain stimulation: Trends and future directions
title_zh: 猕猴脑刺激系统综述：趋势与未来方向
abstract: Neurostimulation techniques can powerfully modulate neural circuit activity and provide causal insights into the relationship between brain function and behavior. Macaque monkeys have long been a key animal model for brain stimulation studies. While stimulating the macaque brain with one or a few electrodes has already taught us much about brain function and dysfunction, recent technological advances promise a future with more precise stimulation using many more electrodes. However, such possibilities also increase the number of choices an experimenter has when designing their study. We can learn from a rich past, but a comprehensive overview of which brain regions have been studied and with what stimulation parameters is lacking. Here, we present a PRISMA-compliant systematic review of 734 macaque brain stimulation studies using electrical and/or optogenetic stimulation. We find a striking bias in which brain areas have traditionally been stimulated: a mere 10 brain regions account for half of all studies, with the remainder of studies investigating approximately 150 other areas. Across studies, stimulation frequency robustly predicted direct behavioral effects independent of brain region, while amplitude did not. Future studies could more systematically explore less studied regions through lower stimulation frequencies (e.g., 20-50 Hz) alongside established ranges (∼200 Hz). Tools such as fMRI or optical imaging can capture neural circuit engagement evoked by these frequencies, even when behavioral effects are absent or remain subtle. Our synthesis offers a guide towards the next steps in high-channel-count, high-precision stimulation approaches.
abstract_zh: 神经刺激技术能够强有力地调节神经回路活动，并为脑功能与行为之间的关系提供因果洞察。猕猴长期以来一直是脑刺激研究的关键动物模型。虽然使用一到少数电极刺激猕猴大脑已让我们了解许多脑功能与功能障碍，但近期技术进步预示着未来将使用更多电极实现更精确的刺激。然而，这些可能性也增加了实验者在设计研究时的选择。我们可以从丰富的过去中学习，但关于已研究的脑区及其刺激参数的全面综述仍然缺失。本文呈现了一份符合 PRISMA 标准的系统综述，涵盖了 734 篇使用电刺激和/或光遗传刺激的猕猴脑刺激研究。我们发现传统上刺激的脑区存在显著偏倚：仅有 10 个脑区占据了所有研究的一半，其余研究则涉及约 150 个其他区域。跨研究分析显示，刺激频率稳健地预测了直接的行为效应，而幅度则未能预测。未来研究可通过更系统地探索较少研究的区域，采用低频刺激（如 20-50 Hz）与已建立的频段（约 200 Hz）相结合。fMRI 或光学成像等工具可捕捉这些频率诱发的神经回路参与，即使行为效应缺失或仍然微弱。我们的综合为高通道数、高精度刺激方法的下一步提供了指导。
